advisories.detail: Pins bind bytes, not repository commits, because many pinned architecture inputs are untracked or locally modified. Acceptance should cite the frozen manifest and input-pins.json hashes.
check.py enforces semantic equality, so a reformatted v3 passes it. Byte exactness rests on the frozen manifest, and this review confirmed the byte form.

v3 keeps the historical standing text and subjectManifest fields of metadata-v2 by design. Downstream consumers must bind successor.json and the frozen manifest for current standing, not v3's embedded prose.
On acceptance, report05 or successor work must remove its scopedValidatorWorkaround and bind this successor explicitly. That rebase is not performed here.
